verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents a single-call pre-recorded transcription endpoint (POST /v1/listen with model=nova-3) that returns the transcript directly, plus an optional callback URL for async delivery. Its docs are agent-readable: llms.txt with explicit AI-agent instructions, clean .md pages and a live openapi.json all probe at HTTP 200. A dg CLI that transcribes files and auto-detects agent environments, plus an MCP server, offer further no-human paths. The 2018 broken-docs-link report is superseded by the current HTTP 200 probes and does not dispute this. Missing for 10: the API-key auth header scheme is not explicitly shown in the evidence, and there is no independent hands-on report of an agent running submission to transcript unassisted.
